business.name: Greenville Tire & Auto Repair
business.tagline: Greenville's one-stop tire and auto shop.
business.description: New and used tires, brakes, A/C, suspension and engine work — foreign and domestic, all in the same bays on Commerce Drive. Quoted before we start, most of it done the same day.

headings.trust: Why Hunt County keeps coming back

services.name: New tires
services.detail: BFGoodrich, Milestar, Westlake and more. Passenger, truck and off-road, mounted and balanced on site.

services.name: Used tires
services.detail: Quality takeoffs at a fraction of new. We'll tell you honestly how much life is left.

services.name: Tire repair
services.detail: Patches and plugs done properly. Flats, slow leaks and road hazard damage.

services.name: Custom wheels & lift kits
services.detail: Lift kits, oversized tires and aftermarket rims — the truck work plenty of shops turn away.

services.name: Brakes & rotors
services.detail: Pads, rotors and full brake service. Inspected before we quote.

services.name: Oil changes
services.detail: Synthetic blend special at $32 for the first 5 quarts, $5 each after. Full synthetic $52, $10 a quart after 5.

services.name: Suspension & steering
services.detail: Struts, shocks, control arms, tie rods and steering repair.

services.name: Air conditioning
services.detail: Recharge, leak diagnosis and component replacement — worth doing before August.

services.name: Engine diagnostics
services.detail: Check-engine scans and drivability troubleshooting on the actual cause, not a guess at parts.

services.name: Battery, starter & alternator
services.detail: Free testing, fast replacement, back on the road the same visit.

services.name: Filters & maintenance
services.detail: Air and cabin filters, fluids and the scheduled service that keeps the big bills away.

coverage.heading: Right on Commerce Drive
coverage.summary: The blue building on Commerce Drive with the tires stacked out front. Three bays, walk-ins welcome, and one shop that handles the whole list instead of sending you somewhere else for half of it.
coverage.note: Pull in during business hours or call ahead — we'll tell you what it takes before you commit.

process.title: Pull in or call ahead
process.detail: Walk-ins welcome. A flat, a noise, a warning light or a full set of tires — tell us and we'll get eyes on it.

process.title: We look, then we quote
process.detail: We find the actual problem before we price it. Nothing gets added without asking you first.

process.title: Most of it, same day
process.detail: Tires, brakes, oil and routine service go out the same visit. Bigger jobs get a timeline up front.

trustPoints.title: One shop, not four
trustPoints.detail: Tires, brakes, A/C, suspension and engine work happen in the same bays. Nobody sends you across town for the next thing.

trustPoints.title: Foreign and domestic
trustPoints.detail: The work truck, the commuter and the kid's first car all get handled here.

trustPoints.title: New or used, your call
trustPoints.detail: Full range of tire price points. We'll tell you honestly which one your vehicle actually needs.

trustPoints.title: Credit isn't the gate
trustPoints.detail: Acima and Snap Finance. A bald tire is a safety problem, not a credit decision.

trustPoints.title: Quoted before we start
trustPoints.detail: You approve a number first. No mystery line items when you come to pay.

trustPoints.title: Se habla español
trustPoints.detail: Explicamos el trabajo y el precio en español, sin apuros.

callout.title: Credit shouldn't decide whether you drive safely
callout.body: Acima and Snap Finance approve regardless of credit history. Get the tires or the repair now and pay it out over time — because worn brakes don't wait for payday.

cta.title: Whatever it needs, we do it here.
cta.body: Pull into Commerce Drive or call. We'll look at it, tell you straight what it takes, and price it before we touch it.
